asks: Give the technical term for a sequence of steps that describe how to solve a problem. [1]
note: 题目给出描述,要你说出术语名称;一个词就得分。

asks: State the purpose of applying abstraction to this problem. [1]
ms: To filter out information (that is not necessary to solve the problem) // to include only essential information
note: 不是“变得抽象难懂”,而是把解题不需要的信息去掉,只留必需的。

asks: ThisArray[n] ← 42 — The technical term for the variable n in the pseudocode statement.
note: 方括号里用来指出第几个元素的那个变量或数值。

asks: ThisArray[n] ← 42 — The technical terms for minimum and maximum values that the variable n may take.
note: 指下标能取的最小值和最大值(ARRAY[1:10] 的 1 和 10),不是数组里存的数据的范围。

asks: Give the technical term for the item labelled B in the diagram. Explain the meaning of the value given to this item. [2]
ms: Name: Null pointer. Meaning: There are no further nodes in the list
note: 链表最后一个节点的指针取一个特殊值,表示后面没有节点了;并不是“指向一个空节点”。

asks: Two types of program modules may be used in the design of the program. Identify the type of program module that should be used to return a value. [1]
Identify the type of module that should be used for CheckFiles(). [1]
note: 两种模块中返回一个值的那种;另一种是过程(procedure),不返回值。

asks: Explain the term procedure interface with reference to procedure Unpack(). [2]
ms: Provides a mechanism to allow calling program to pass data // Defines the (four) parameters of Unpack() // … giving their data type and order (max 2)
note: 不是界面(屏幕),而是过程头里规定的参数:有哪些、什么类型、什么顺序,调用的程序靠它传数据进来。

asks: Identify the type of construct used in this pseudocode. [1]
State the type of loop structure that would be the most appropriate to use and justify why it is the most appropriate. [2]
ms: Count-control(led) loop // Count-control(led) iteration. Justification: The number of iterations required is known
note: 就是 FOR … NEXT:执行次数事先知道。

asks: Identify the type of loop and state the condition that ends the loop. [2]
Give the name of a suitable loop structure that could be used. Justify your answer. [2]
ms: Type: pre-condition. Justification: the number of iterations is not known // loop ends following a specific input
note: 就是 WHILE … ENDWHILE:先判断条件再执行,可能一次都不执行。

asks: Identify the type of programming construct used in the pseudocode. [1]
note: 就是 REPEAT … UNTIL:先执行再判断,至少执行一次。

asks: One type of maintenance is called perfective. Name two other types of maintenance that the program may require and give a reason for each. [4]
ms: Type: Corrective. Reason: The program does not operate as expected / contains a bug
note: 改错:程序有 bug,运行结果不对。

asks: One type of maintenance is called perfective. Name two other types of maintenance that the program may require and give a reason for each. [4]

The hardware that runs the program is changed and the program needs to be modified so that it works with the new hardware. Identify the type of maintenance that this represents and give one other reason why this type of maintenance may be needed. [2]
ms: Type: Adaptive. Reason: To accommodate a change in the (user) requirement / technology / legislation
note: 程序没有错,是外部变了(需求、硬件、法规),程序要跟着改。

asks: Some time later, changes are made to the program to improve the speed of response. State the type of maintenance that has been applied to the program. [1]
note: 程序没有错、需求也没变,只是改得更好(更快、更好用)。
